compatibility.notes: Public display name Prototype is independent of canonical asset id software.prototype.

do_not_use_when.text: The question can be resolved by reading, reasoning, or existing repository inspection without new code
The work has crossed into production code paths and prototype discipline no longer applies
The question requires a full implementation rather than the cheapest disposable evidence

use_when.text: A design question cannot be answered by reasoning alone and requires empirical evidence at limited fidelity
The cost of building the prototype must remain disposable so the artifact does not become implicit production code
The resulting evidence must be preserved as a decision record rather than rediscovered later

evidence_outputs.description: Empirical answer to the bounded design question.
evidence_outputs.name: design_evidence

evidence_outputs.description: Durable decision record linking question, evidence, and conclusion.
evidence_outputs.name: decision_record

inputs.description: Single explicit question the prototype exists to answer, framed so yes or no plus evidence is meaningful.
inputs.name: design_question

inputs.description: Cheapest fidelity sufficient to answer the question and the explicit cost or scope ceiling.
inputs.name: fidelity_envelope

inputs.description: Where the resulting evidence and decision record must be stored for future retrieval.
inputs.name: evidence_preservation_target

outputs.description: Cheapest disposable artifact scoped to the design question.
outputs.name: prototype_artifact

outputs.description: Empirical evidence that answers the design question.
outputs.name: design_evidence

outputs.description: Durable decision record linking the question, evidence, and conclusion for later retrieval.
outputs.name: decision_record

preconditions.description: The design question is concrete enough that evidence can answer it.
Scope is explicitly bounded so the prototype does not silently become production code.

capability.purpose: Build the cheapest disposable artifact with enough fidelity to answer one explicit design question and preserve the resulting evidence.

requirements.description: The design question is answered with empirical evidence from the prototype.
Prototype does not silently graduate to production code paths.
Evidence and decision record are stored in the preservation target for later retrieval.
